verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a first-party MCP server that lets AI assistants and agents operate the account through natural-language requests: asking about card spend, paying vendors, pulling statements, managing cards and submitting reimbursements. Natural-language operation therefore depends on an external AI client connected to that server, and no native in-app conversational interface is documented. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language command interface inside Jeeves itself, hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation, and documentation of supported prompts or how commands are confirmed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Jeeves MCP server lets AI assistants and autonomous agents manage your company's finances — ask about card spend, pay a vendor, pull a statement, or submit a reimbursement, all without opening the Jeeves app.
Manage cards — list and filter company cards, issue new virtual cards, update names, spending limits, and reset intervals.
Handle reimbursements — submit a reimbursement with receipts attached, check status, and configure the payout account.
Understand your spend — query transactions with filters, export filtered transactions to CSV, review company accounts and balances.
